newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FOCUS-Mystery buyer raids Australia's Burns Philp.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Mystery buyer raids Australia's Burns Philp.

text.p: A mystery buyer launched a surprise raid on Australian spices and yeast group Burns Philp & Co on Friday, buying a 14-percent stake and sparking speculation of an imminent takeover bid.

Broker Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) said on Friday it had bought 78.16 million shares in spices and yeast group Burns Philp & Co Ltd at A$2.50 a share for a client that was not an international food group.
The DMG offer price was 47 cents or 23 percent above Burns' A$2.03 closing price on Thursday.
DMG director Robin Yandle told Reuters he would be active in the stock again later on Friday either as a buyer or a seller, depending on the price.
"We've bought 78.16 million shares or 14 percent of Burns Philp, all at A$2.50 a share, from a range of sellers, both domestic and international," Yandle said.
He said there had been 40 sellers and one buyer.

Yandle confirmed that the buyer was not an international food group and that he considered Australia's Goodman Fielder Ltd -- rumoured to be mulling a takeover bid -- to be aninternational food group.
